name: Habitat Protection and Restoration grants
summary: Grants for protecting and restoring habitat for Great Lakes fish in the Lake Michigan basin and Michigan, including fish passage, dam removal, in-stream restoration and targeted land acquisition.

applicant_types.quote: Organizations eligible to apply for GLFT grants include nonprofit organizations, educational, and governmental (including tribal) organizations.

geography.quote: Projects must be located in the Lake Michigan basin or within the state of Michigan.

access.quote: Staff are available to assist applicants with navigating the online grant proposal submission process.

window.quote: The RFP is planned for release annually in the winter.

co_finance_required.quote: Match funding is not required; however, proposals that include local funding and promote community participation in the use of fishery resources will be favored.
